title: Flash Flood Warning
description: FFWFFC The National Weather Service in Peachtree City has issued a * Flash Flood Warning for... Southwestern Gilmer County in north central Georgia... Northeastern Pickens County in north central Georgia... * Until 515 AM EDT. * At 1118 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing heavy rain across the warned area. title: Flood Warning
description: ...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in Texas... Nueces River Near Three Rivers affecting Live Oak County. ...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Texas... Nueces River Near Tilden affecting McMullen County. For the Nueces River...including Tilden, Three Rivers...Major flooding is forecast. * WHAT...Major flooding is forecast. * WHERE...Nueces River near Three Rivers. * WHEN...From Wednesday afternoon until further notice. * IMPACTS...At 40.0 feet, Significant flooding reaches miles from the main channel, flooding homes in the flood plain near Three Rivers to Lake Corpus Christi. Up to 4 feet of water is in River Creek Acres Subdivision, flooding several homes. Kellner Camp along County Road 336 floods, with water several feet deep surrounding homes. Antelope Lane is flooded cutting off access to J.I. Hailey Subdivision at Jones River bend. Water approaches the base of homes along the river in Buckeye Knoll Subdivision, 2 miles west of Swinny Switch. * ADDITIONAL DETAILS... - At 8:15 PM CDT Tuesday the stage was 12.2 feet. - Bankfull stage is 20.0 feet. - Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage tomorrow afternoon and continue rising to a crest of 40.4 feet Friday evening. - Flood stage is 25.0 feet. - Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 40.6 feet on 07/11/2007. - http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
